# Compose command-label tests wait for pending Fluent mutations after focus changes

The compose attachment test changes focus and selection before checking cmd_delete. The command controllers now assign default-delete-cmd or remove-attachment-cmd through document.l10n.setAttributes. Each of five existing label checks first waits for L10nMutationsFinished when the document reports pending localization mutations. This establishes the intended label-check barrier; the test remains a static historical example with English expected labels and its existing platform-specific focus helper.

Scope: Compose attachment command tests.
